blurb: The Ojai Art Center is the longest continuously-operating multi-disciplinary center serving the arts in the State of California. We opened in 1939, marking over 85 years in operation! The Ojai Art Center Theater Branch annually presents a year-long season of productions, ranging from comedies to dramas and musicals.
